test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Two trains 121 m and 99 m in length, respectively, are running in opposite directions, one at a speed of 40 km/h and the other at a speed of 32 km/h. In what time will they be completely clear of each other from the moment they meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of two trains are 121 m and 99 m running in opposite directions

Speed of 1st train is 40 km/h 

Speed of 2ⁿd train is 32 km/h 

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**Calculation:**

Here, we have total length of the train = (121 + 99) = 220 m&am
